subject.title: Support installing all skills/plugins from a publisher

question: Should ClawHub add publisher-wide install support, and what CLI/API safety contract should that feature expose?
rationale: Bulk installing all content from a publisher changes the trust, moderation, plugin compatibility, and command taxonomy contract; automation cannot choose those product and safety semantics safely.

options.title: Approve a scoped design first
options.body: Define the command namespace, family filters, preview/confirmation, safety gates, and partial-failure behavior before implementation.

options.title: Defer behind CLI consolidation
options.body: Keep this request open but wait for the CLI taxonomy decision in https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2317 before choosing a command shape.

options.title: Decline bulk install
options.body: Keep publisher pages and package listings as browse surfaces and require explicit per-item installs for safety.

recommendation.title: Approve a scoped design first
recommendation.body: Define the command namespace, family filters, preview/confirmation, safety gates, and partial-failure behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is both the collaborator requester and the strongest recent history owner for the CLI install/publisher catalog surfaces involved.
